residential.name: Residential: self-contained dwelling units, all usages

residentialPublic.name: Residential: communal areas of blocks of flats, hotel bedrooms and corridors

operatingRoom.name: Hospitals: operating theatres, X-ray rooms, utility rooms

retailUpper.name: Shops: areas for the display and sale of merchandise

storageLight.name: Storage: general (2.4 kN/m² per metre of storage height; this row for 3 m)

roof.name: Roof: no access except for maintenance (BS 6399-3)

sources.uses: BS 6399-1:1996 Table 1: the rows SAEngine lists (the category of each row named in VERIFY.md)
sources.uses.roof: BS 6399-3:1988 4.3.1: flat or pitched up to 30°, no access except for cleaning and maintenance, 0.6 kN/m² or 0.9 kN
sources.uses.roofAccess: BS 6399-3:1988 4.2: access provided, as the floor loads of the use (1.5 kN/m², 1.8 kN taken)
